scene_intent: 填写本图实际情境：谁在何处做什么，与哪件道具互动。
subject_details: 填写已选主角数量、当前衣服、动作、视线、表情、遮挡和关键道具；区分原片可见、用户说明、获准设计补全。

references.use_for: 只参考实际认可的线条、五官概括与角色比例；衣服和动作按本图，不复制参考的家具或文案。

template_note: Replace relative paths and text with actual reviewed inputs. Inputs are not included in the package. Set inputs_reviewed=true only after viewing every selected image. For private profile references use reference_ids with an explicit --profile; do not package that profile. For a genuinely unresolved style use needed with 2-3 actual displayed candidate options (id/label/description), wait for an explicit answer, then use resolved in a new run. Delegate only when the user asks you to choose; never default to the first option on timeout.
